subject.title: Docs landing page: stale brand hero, missing fourth quick-start card, fallback card icons

question: Should maintainers proceed with the linked docs brand refresh once its locale-asset compatibility concern is fixed and the companion docs-site icon renderer PR is coordinated?
rationale: The issue carries a protected `maintainer` label and the proposed solution spans user-visible brand/docs presentation plus a separate docs-site renderer change, so automation should not create a competing repair path.

options.title: Land coordinated refresh
options.body: Fix the linked PR's locale-asset compatibility issue, coordinate the docs-site icon PR, and close this issue after both relevant pieces land.

options.title: Narrow the OpenClaw PR
options.body: Land only the README/docs landing-card and palette changes here while leaving icon-rendering work to the docs-site repository.

options.title: Defer the brand refresh
options.body: Keep the issue open for a later maintainer-led docs direction pass if the current asset or mascot direction is not settled.

recommendation.title: Land coordinated refresh
recommendation.body: Fix the linked PR's locale-asset compatibility issue, coordinate the docs-site icon PR, and close this issue after both relevant pieces land.
